name: STAR Geodesy — Mercator and Web Mercator
summary: Mercator projection on the ellipsoid with optional latitude of true scale, forward, inverse and scale factor, and Web Mercator; within 6e-8 m of PROJ, 7.5e-9 m of PyGeodesy's isometric latitude and 3e-8 m of both for Web Mercator on 600 cases; reproduces Snyder's published x and scale factor.
reference: Snyder, Map Projections - A Working Manual (USGS PP 1395), p. 266: Clarke 1866, central meridian 180, point 35 N 75 W: x = 11688673.7 m, k = 1.2194146
reference_observed: x = 11688673.715, k = 1.21941461: within 0.015 m and 8.4e-9 of the printed values

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees and metres; x East, y North; Web Mercator kept as separate functions so the two cannot be confused
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; Newton iteration capped at 10 steps; inverse longitudes kept in [-180, 180)
